rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something steady, regular, and dependable over time.

example.english: The service at this shop has been consistent all along.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅服務一直都好穩定。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 fuk6 mou6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 wan2 ding6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being dependable or able to be trusted, rather than merely regular.

example.english: This technician is very consistent; you can count on him whenever there is a problem.
example.traditional: 呢位師傅做嘢好可靠，有問題搵佢就得。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 si1 fu6 zou6 je5 hou2 ho2 kaau3 jau5 man6 tai4 wan2 keoi5 zau6 dak1
